dead-letter:posting-sub.title: Failed messages are dropped
dead-letter:posting-sub.message: Ledger worker fails messages in “Poison invoices”, and ledger-posting has no dead-letter queue: messages that run out of deliveries (10) are lost.
dead-letter:posting-sub.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.

dead-letter:approval-sub.title: approval-workflow has no dead-letter queue
dead-letter:approval-sub.message: If Invoice approval can't handle a message, it's dropped after 10 deliveries. A command queue is where losing messages hurts most.
dead-letter:approval-sub.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.

no-reader:dlq.title: Dead letters pile up in invoice.commands DLQ
no-reader:dlq.message: Nothing in the diagram reads or alerts on invoice.commands DLQ: failed messages stay there until someone looks.
no-reader:dlq.rationale: A dead-letter queue has no automatic cleanup. Someone should be told when messages land there, and be able to replay them.

fix.label: Add a reader…
fix.choice: Pick what reads invoice.commands DLQ, then add it and connect dlq to it.
